## Activity

During October 2022, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 70 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity level provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes across the site. The results below summarise the proportion of captures that could not be graded, the number assessed as referable, and the time taken for grading.

## Image quality

Of the 70 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.3. These captures could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the captures that received a grading outcome. Image quality should continue to be monitored through routine site review, with attention to any recurring factors that may affect the ability to grade captures.

## Grading

There were 8 referable results during October 2022. The median lag for grading was 1 day. Together, these measures describe the grading workload and the timeliness of the reported outcomes for the month. Overall, the activity, image-quality and grading figures provide the operational summary for Oakridge Primary Care.
